declaration.hypothesis_class: NEW_POST_HOC proposed AFTER the diag09/diag10 outcomes
declaration.motivating_outcome: diag09 result results/diag09/diag09_precision_gradients.json (main-s0/final whole relL2 0.1091057353, cosine 0.9940303022, loss_rel 0.0184; distortion grows with memorization depth)
declaration.causality_scope: POINTWISE numeric mechanism on saved checkpoint values ONLY; NOT historical learning causation; the stable loss cannot be described as fixing past grokking or changing any course outcome

hypothesis.name: float32 log-softmax cross-entropy gradient cancellation
hypothesis.statement: The frozen loss computes nll = -log_softmax(logits)[target]; at nearly zero training loss p_true rounds to exactly 1.0 in float32, so the gradient term (p_true - 1) cancels to 0 and per-class gradient contributions lose the small residual signal. An algebraically equivalent form that never forms p_true - 1, s = logsumexp(logits with target masked to -inf) - target_logit; loss = softplus(s) = log(1 + sum_{j!=y} exp(z_j - z_y)), should produce a float32 gradient materially closer to the float64 reference on the same saved values.
hypothesis.mathematical_equivalence: d loss/d z_y = -(1-p_y) and d loss/d z_j = p_j (j != y) for both forms; verified in float64 as the harness gate

fixed_inputs.checkpoints: checkpoint-final.npz of main-s0..s4 (ALL FIVE declared as one fixed set before execution; s0 is the hypothesis target, seeds 1-4 are fixed controls; no cherry-picking, no new seeds)
fixed_inputs.batch: full frozen train batch (grok.fixed_split(0.30), 2823 pairs); no subsets
fixed_inputs.weights: loaded float32 arrays, explicitly cast for float64 passes; init_params NEVER called; no regeneration

metrics.relL2: ||g_a - g_ref||_2 / ||g_ref||_2 on flattened full-batch mean-loss gradients, float64 container
metrics.reference: float64 ORIGINAL frozen-form gradient (ground truth on identical values)

procedure_order: ALL float32 passes (fixtures + 5 checkpoints, original and stable forms) -> single x64 toggle with dtype assertions -> ALL float64 passes; no global dtype contamination; flags recorded

harness_gate.rule: reject wrapper/harness if float64 loss or gradient disagrees across the two equivalent forms beyond 1e-9 abs + 1e-7 relative (per-example/per-coordinate on analytic fixtures AND full-batch raw values)
harness_gate.on_failure: diagnostic invalid; failure retained as attempt01; no threshold or form tuning

support_criterion_engineering_not_course.rule: float32 stable-form gradient closer to the float64 reference by at least 10x (ratio of relL2, original/stable) AND stable relL2 < 1e-3
support_criterion_engineering_not_course.supported_means: cancellation is a LOCAL cause of the measured float32-vs-float64 gradient discrepancy at that snapshot ONLY
support_criterion_engineering_not_course.not_supported_means: declare unresolved numeric mechanism; no threshold/form tuning
support_criterion_engineering_not_course.verdict_granularity: per checkpoint; overall supported iff main-s0/final meets the criterion, with all four controls reported
support_criterion_engineering_not_course.scope_limit: even full support does not establish that this mechanism caused seed0's non-grokking within 10000 steps, and the stable form is NOT a fix for past training
